reviewed_by: ChatGPT (GPT-6, AI reviewer), as stated in its review relayed by the repository owner
candidate_provenance: AI-drafted, AI-reviewed three times (drafting session; external AI reviews 2026-11-20, revisions 2 and 3). Not human-approved: freezing needs the human reviewer's name and date.

requirements.requirement: Summarize the PR's intent in one sentence before reviewing structure, details or tests.
requirements.quote: Summarize the PR's intent in one sentence before proceeding.

requirements.requirement: If the intent cannot be summarized, ask the author to clarify instead of continuing the review.
requirements.quote: If you cannot, ask the author to clarify.

requirements.requirement: Read the PR description and understand the problem being solved.
requirements.quote: Read PR description, understand the problem being solved.

requirements.requirement: Review architecture and design: whether the change follows existing codebase patterns and whether new abstractions are justified.
requirements.quote: Does this follow existing patterns in the codebase? Are new abstractions justified?

requirements.requirement: Check code quality, security and performance, including N+1 queries, hardcoded secrets and injection risks.
requirements.quote: Are there N+1 queries, hardcoded secrets, or injection risks?

requirements.requirement: Check for security issues with the OWASP Top 10 as the baseline.
requirements.quote: Check for security issues (OWASP Top 10 as baseline)

requirements.requirement: Validate tests: edge cases are covered and tests assert behavior, not implementation.
requirements.quote: Are edge cases covered? Do tests assert behavior, not implementation?

requirements.requirement: Review tests as thoroughly as code.
requirements.quote: Review tests as thoroughly as code

requirements.requirement: Note critical issues as soon as they are found, not only at the end.
requirements.quote: If critical issues are found in step 3, note them immediately and do not wait until the end.

requirements.requirement: When the author explained a non-obvious choice in comments, acknowledge that reasoning before suggesting an alternative.
requirements.quote: acknowledge their reasoning before suggesting an alternative

requirements.requirement: When a linter or formatter is configured, do not block on style preferences or nitpick style.
requirements.quote: Never block on style preferences when a linter or formatter is configured.

requirements.requirement: Do not block on personal preferences.
requirements.quote: Block on personal preferences

requirements.requirement: Do not be condescending or rude.
requirements.quote: Be condescending or rude

requirements.requirement: Do not demand perfection.
requirements.quote: Demand perfection

requirements.requirement: Do not review without understanding why the change was made.
requirements.quote: Review without understanding the why

requirements.requirement: Give specific, actionable feedback.
requirements.quote: Provide specific, actionable feedback

requirements.requirement: Include code examples in suggestions.
requirements.quote: Include code examples in suggestions

requirements.requirement: Praise good patterns; never skip praising good work.
requirements.quote: Praise good patterns

requirements.requirement: Prioritize feedback from critical to minor.
requirements.quote: Prioritize feedback (critical → minor)

requirements.requirement: The report contains a summary (one-sentence intent recap and overall assessment), critical, major and minor issues, positive feedback, questions for the author, and a verdict.
requirements.quote: Code review report must include:

requirements.requirement: The verdict is one of Approve, Request Changes or Comment.
requirements.quote: Approve / Request Changes / Comment

requirements.requirement: Review only: read and search code; never edit files or run commands (derived from the tool allowlist, not stated in the prose; an allowlist limits the skill's tools, it is not host-enforced isolation).
requirements.quote: allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob
